HockeyAllsvenskan Play-by-play

Source: R/ha.R
ha_pbp.Rd

One game's events (2025/26 onward): shots with outcome, goals with assists and strength, penalties, goalkeeper changes, timeouts. No coordinates, no on-ice players.

One row per event (Shot, Goal, Penalty, GoalkeeperEvent, Timeout); time is seconds into the period. The body names no game, so statnet_game_number, home_statnet_id and away_statnet_id come from the request. team_statnet_id is the StatNet team id and team_code the display code; player_statnet_id is the StatNet player id (the same id space as SHL's isa id). Goals carry running_score, the strength in event_description and the assists by NAME (assist1_name). No shot coordinates, no on-ice players. Get the four required ids from a row of ha_schedule() or ha_game().

Usage

ha_pbp(
  statnet_game_number,
  home_statnet_id,
  away_statnet_id,
  scheduled_date_time,
  played_date_time = NULL,
  return_parsed = TRUE
)

Arguments

statnet_game_number

StatNet game number (statnet_game_number in ha_schedule / ha_game), e.g. 23401.

home_statnet_id

StatNet team id of the home team, e.g. AIK.

away_statnet_id

StatNet team id of the away team, e.g. MODO.

scheduled_date_time

Scheduled start (scheduled_date_time in ha_schedule), ISO 8601 UTC. Required by the site.

played_date_time

Actual start (played_date_time), ISO 8601 UTC. Optional. NULL = not sent.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the raw JSON as a list (stamped with the request under _request where the body does not say what it answers).

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE), else the raw JSON list:

col_nametypedescription
statnet_game_numberintegerStatNet game number (23401 = 2026/27 game 1); the play-by-play request key.
home_statnet_idcharacterStatNet team id of the home team (AIK, MODO, MIK).
away_statnet_idcharacterStatNet team id of the away team.
periodintegerPeriod number the event belongs to.
period_labelcharacterPeriod label ('Period 1').
event_typecharacterEvent type: Shot, Goal, Penalty, GoalkeeperEvent or Timeout.
timeintegerSeconds into the period.
is_enteringlogicalGoalkeeper event: true when the goalkeeper enters, false when he leaves.
team_namecharacterTeam label as shown on the card (the display team code).
team_codecharacterDisplay code of the team (AIK, MoDo, MORA, NVIF, ÖIK), not the StatNet id.
team_statnet_idcharacterStatNet team id (AIK, MODO, MIK, NYB, OSIK), not the display code.
player_statnet_idintegerStatNet player id (the same id space as SHL's isa id, verified on one player).
player_first_namecharacterPlayer: first name of the player.
player_family_namecharacterPlayer: family name of the player.
player_jersey_numberintegerPlayer: jersey number of the player.
event_descriptioncharacterShot outcome, goal strength (EQ), penalty text or timeout note.
running_scorecharacterScore after the goal, home-away.
scorer_season_goalsintegerScorer's season goals after this goal.
is_penalty_shotlogicalGoal scored on a penalty shot.
assist1_namecharacterFirst assist, by name (no id).
assist1_jersey_todayintegerFirst assist's jersey number in this game.
assist1_season_assistsintegerFirst assist's season assists after this goal.
assist2_namecharacterSecond assist, by name (no id).
assist2_jersey_todayintegerSecond assist's jersey number in this game.
assist2_season_assistsintegerSecond assist's season assists after this goal.

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the site has nothing for the request (a season before 2005/06, an unknown or pre-2025/26 game, a phase not played, a body without rows). fastRhockey_bad_request: a value outside its enumerated set, a field the site requires is missing, or HTTP 400/422. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: any other non-2xx, a connection failure after retries, or an empty, non-JSON, error-shaped, truncated or out-of-scope 200 (the answer is unknown, not empty).

See also

Other HA Functions: ha_game(), ha_games(), ha_goalie_stats(), ha_leaders(), ha_players(), ha_schedule(), ha_skater_stats(), ha_standings(), ha_team_stats(), ha_teams()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(ha_pbp(
    statnet_game_number = 23401, home_statnet_id = "AIK", away_statnet_id = "MODO",
    scheduled_date_time = "2026-09-18T17:00:00.000Z"
  ))
